requirement: Encrypt secrets under the newest of several Fernet keys, keep decrypting tokens made with older keys, re-wrap old tokens under the newest key, and optionally refuse tokens older than a maximum age.
skeleton: A Vault class building a MultiFernet from keys newest first, with seal, unseal passing ttl, and rotate delegating to MultiFernet.rotate.
caption: Fernet key rotation with the cryptography library. Vault(keys) takes keys newest first, raises ValueError saying at least one key is required when the list is empty, and wraps them in MultiFernet, which encrypts with the first key and tries every key when decrypting. seal(plaintext) encrypts the UTF-8 bytes. unseal(token, max_age=None) decrypts with ttl=max_age and decodes UTF-8, so a token from an unknown key or older than max_age seconds raises InvalidToken. rotate(token) calls MultiFernet.rotate, re-encrypting an old token under the newest key while keeping its original timestamp. The fixture asserts that a sealed café decrypts with the newest key alone and round-trips, that a token made with the old key still unseals, that a rotated token opens with the newest key and raises InvalidToken under the old key, that a stranger's token raises InvalidToken, that a token stamped 100 seconds ago opens without max_age but raises InvalidToken with max_age 10, and that an empty key list raises ValueError.

plan.intent: Rotate encryption keys without losing existing ciphertexts
constraints: New tokens are encrypted with the first, newest key
Tokens from any listed key decrypt
rotate re-encrypts under the newest key
Unknown keys or tokens older than max_age raise InvalidToken
Text is UTF-8 on both sides
An empty key list raises ValueError

rationale.teaches: MultiFernet orders keys newest first, decrypts with all of them, and rotate moves old tokens forward, while ttl enforces freshness.
rationale.why: A single Fernet key makes every rotation a flag day, and putting the new key last keeps encrypting with the key being retired.

ops.docstring: Encrypt with the newest Fernet key while older keys still decrypt and re-wrap.

candidates.why_wrong: Keys are reversed, so new tokens and rotations use the oldest key.
Only the newest key is loaded, so tokens made with older keys no longer decrypt.
max_age is never passed as ttl, so stale tokens are accepted.
An empty key list fails inside MultiFernet with a message that never mentions keys.
Text is encoded as Latin-1 but decoded as UTF-8, so non-ASCII text breaks.
